description: The 2026 humanoid robot half-marathon begins with a starting shot in Beijing's Yizhuang district. Compared with last year's inaugural event, the number of participating teams in this edition has increased nearly fivefold. The competition has introduced two innovative race modes: autonomous navigation and remote control, with robots competing on the same track and ranked under a unified standard. Over a hundred humanoid robot teams showcase their technologies and racing side by side. Join us to follow this spectacular event featuring technology and speed, intelligence and endurance.
